description: This file defines the StreamDecoratorTrait trait, which provides a set of default method implementations for decorating StreamInterface objects in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library. It includes methods for stream management, such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata access, as well as magic methods for string conversion, property access, and method forwarding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trait with a StreamInterface object to decorate.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access or initialize the 'stream' property dynamically.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string, seeking to the start if seekable, handling exceptions appropriately.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the entire contents of the stream as a string using a utility function.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the wrapped stream object, returning either the result or the decorator itself for fluent interfaces.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from the underlying stream.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying stream from the decorator.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses for creating streams dynamically.
